site_or_case_name: Central Terminal Area at the airport

layers.soil_description: Highly compressible organic tidal marsh deposits (thickness 1 to 3 m)
Glacial outwash sands of varying gradation and density (thickness approx. 50 m)
Compact clays and sands extending to bedrock

additional_notes: Layer depths for the top two strata are represented using midpoint thicknesses (4.0 m for 3-5 m hydraulic sand fill and 2.0 m for 1-3 m organic deposits). Glacial sands have fine to medium gradation (Cu = 2.1) and average relative density of 40% to 60%. Bedrock is at approximately 200 m depth. No SPT N or CPT qc plots or numerical values are shown in this figure.
